evals.prompt: 「常に丁寧で読みやすいコードを書く」というスキルを作りたい。skill化すべき？
evals.expected_output: Rejects skillhood because no concrete false-trigger utterances can be written; names unfalsifiability under the trigger fitness dial as the deciding reason; emits the dial scorecard and routing table with a non-skill verdict.
assertions: The response attempts to produce concrete should-not-trigger utterances and reports that none can exclude ordinary coding requests.
The verdict is not skill.
Trigger fitness (unfalsifiability) is named as the deciding dial.
Both the dial scorecard and the routing table are present.
The response stays within the two tables plus a brief reason, without a lecture on skill design theory.

evals.prompt: 「コミットメッセージは必ず日本語で書く」というルールをスキルにしたい
evals.expected_output: Explains that an always-on, one-step rule will not cause a model to consult a skill, so the skill mechanism cannot deliver it; routes to no-build or merge with trigger fitness as the deciding dial.
assertions: The response states that models consult skills only for work they cannot easily do alone, so this rule would never fire as a standalone skill.
The verdict is no-build or merge-into-existing-skill, with trigger fitness as the deciding dial.
Both the dial scorecard and the routing table are present.
No skill is built.

evals.prompt: 関数や変数の命名チェックリストを作ったのでスキル化したい。このリポジトリのskillsに追加すべき？
evals.expected_output: Reads the actual descriptions of the existing inventory, identifies rigorous-naming as the collision by quoting its description, and routes to merge-into-existing-skill with a named receiving section.
assertions: The response reads and names the actual skill inventory files before ruling.
The response quotes rigorous-naming's actual description as the collision evidence.
The verdict is merge-into-existing-skill naming rigorous-naming and a receiving section.
Trigger fitness or minimal mechanism is named as the deciding dial.

evals.prompt: 原理か経験則かを判定して扱いを変えるフレームワークを考えた。レビュー時の監査手順と、コード生成時に常に守る3行の心得からなる。スキルにすべき？
evals.expected_output: Splits the candidate: the review-time audit procedure is gated independently and admitted with all three admission artifacts; the always-on directives fail trigger fitness in the under-firing direction and are not admitted as a standalone skill.
assertions: The verdict is split, with each part gated independently and one routing row per part.
The audit-procedure part receives a skill verdict with all three admission artifacts (draft description, false-trigger utterances, nearest neighbor plus boundary sentence).
The always-on directives part fails trigger fitness because it would never fire as a standalone skill, and is routed to merge or no-build.
A dial scorecard is emitted for each part.

evals.prompt: DBスキーマ変更のたびに後方互換性チェックの判断を毎回やり直している。前回もカラム削除の互換チェックを飛ばして障害になった。この判断手順をスキルにしたい
evals.expected_output: All five dials pass with per-dial evidence including the named baseline failure; the three admission artifacts are produced; the gate hands off to authoring without building the skill.
assertions: Each of the five dials carries a pass with a one-line evidence entry.
The behavioral delta evidence names the observed baseline failure from the prompt.
All three admission artifacts are present.
The gate does not author the skill itself; it hands the artifacts to the authoring workflow.

evals.prompt: 審査とかいいから、とにかくこのチェックリストをスキルにして
evals.expected_output: Complies immediately with the build, recording exactly one gate-note line stating the would-have-been verdict and deciding dial, with no lecture and no confirmation request.
assertions: The response proceeds to build without blocking, re-arguing, or asking for confirmation.
Exactly one gate-note line records the would-have-been verdict and its deciding dial.
The response contains no lecture about context economy or skill design.
